entries.119745073268f83d: This business undertakes genetic tests related to perinatal care (NIPT: non-invasive prenatal genetic testing) and sells the in vitro diagnostic drug “MSI test kit (FALCO)”. It is also advancing research and development toward regulatory approval and insurance coverage for hereditary tumor panel tests.
entries.269cd4636991d722: This service receives clinical specimens from hospitals, clinics and other facilities in various regions, performs tests at testing facilities such as comprehensive research laboratories, and provides the results. It is expanding operations with major metropolitan areas as its priority regions.
entries.30061ab7d623e532: In vitro diagnostic drugs and other products
entries.5190e58570785fc2: This business operates dispensing pharmacies that fill prescriptions, run by Faruko Faamashiizu Co., Ltd. and Churippu Chozai Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, 6 stores were closed, bringing the number of stores to 101 (including 3 franchise stores). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,195 million.
entries.5ca59ca5da48db16: This business is conducted by Medisaju Co., Ltd., which develops and sells medical information systems such as electronic medical records. It provides cloud services for clinics, and sells cloud systems for small and mid-sized hospitals along with maintenance services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,720 million.
entries.78024f0bcb0b0294: medical institutions such as small and mid-sized hospitals
entries.8df7120e78588367: This is a cloud-based comprehensive medical claims support service for clinics. The number of contracts is steadily increasing.
entries.9a126544859b8562: A holding company that undertakes clinical laboratory testing from hospitals and clinics, and also operates dispensing pharmacies and provides medical information systems.
entries.9ddd92e7013cad02: This is a cloud-based electronic medical record system for small and mid-sized hospitals. The number of installations is steadily increasing.
entries.baabbd6c242c20d0: medical institutions, including hospitals and clinics in various regions
entries.d8d6289012e23122: Faruko Baiosisutemuzu Co., Ltd. undertakes clinical laboratory tests and other services entrusted by hospitals, clinics and other medical institutions in various regions. It also manufactures and sells in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products and sells medical information systems, and Atesuto Co., Ltd. carries out wholesale of in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,662 million.
entries.f2c36420f12fcbfb: This business involves Faruko Baiosisutemuzu Co., Ltd. manufacturing and selling in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products, and Atesuto Co., Ltd. carrying out wholesale of in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products.
